name: bombparty
author: Kobi Dao
description: A clean-room desktop word-bomb party game. Electron + React + TypeScript, with a headless deterministic engine.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @bombparty/engine && npm run dev --workspace @bombparty/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bombparty/engine && npm run build --workspace @bombparty/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @bombparty/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @bombparty/engine && npm run typecheck:test --workspace @bombparty/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @bombparty/desktop
